name: International Journal of Education and Learning Futures
school: ACRI School of Education & Human Development (SEHD)
scope: IJELF publishes research on the future of education: learning systems, assessment, pedagogy, educational technology, leadership in schools and universities, teacher development and education policy. It welcomes work that connects evidence to practice in India and around the world.
